notes.title: Gamepad Support
notes.notes: [h2]New Features[/h2][p][b]Full support for keyboard and gamepads has been implemented.[/b] Note: DualShock controllers rely on Steam’s XInput compatibility feature.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Improvements[/h2][p][b]Improved stability when using the T300RS racing wheel.[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]GHUB is no longer required for steering wheel controllers.[/b] The input-related SDK has been replaced to remove this dependency.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI display has been updated to reflect official gamepad support.[/b][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][p][b]Reduced frequent frame drops when playing with kei cars.[/b] This part of the game has been slightly optimized.[/p]
